name: Conference speaker follow-up
description: Follows up with someone after watching their conference talk, using a specific idea from the talk as the reason to connect.
audience: Conference speakers whose talk you watched and found relevant.

variants: Hi {{firstName|there}} — I watched your talk at {{conference|the conference}} about {{topic|the topic}}. Your point on {{highlight|that idea}} stayed with me. Would be great to connect.
Hi {{firstName|there}}, caught your {{conference|conference}} talk on {{topic|the topic}}. I found the discussion around {{highlight|that point}} useful. Happy to connect.
Thanks for connecting, {{firstName|there}}. I especially liked your point about {{highlight|that idea}}. I've been thinking about how it applies to {{context|our work}}.
Appreciate the connection. Your discussion of {{topic|the topic}} gave me a useful perspective, especially around {{highlight|that point}}.
Curious whether your thinking on {{topic|the topic}} has changed since the talk. I'd enjoy comparing notes if you're open to it.
I'd be interested to hear whether you've seen anything new around {{topic|the topic}} since the conference. Happy to swap notes sometime.
